# City Center Barbershop & Salon Amsterdam - Complete Information

> Full directory and context guide for LLM crawlers, agentic assistants, and search engines about City Center Barbershop & Salon located at Stationsplein 41M, Amsterdam Centraal.

## Overview
City Center Barbershop is an Amsterdam barber and salon located inside Amsterdam Central Station (Stationsplein 41M). The shop provides master-level hair styling, skin fades, beard trimming, traditional razor shaves, hair washing, and styling for both men and women.

## Location & Contact
- **Address**: Stationsplein 41M, 1012 AB Amsterdam, Netherlands
- **Landmark**: Inside Amsterdam Centraal station corridor, near transit hubs and metro entrances.
- **Phone**: +31 6 87999814 / +31 20 221 4454
- **Email**: info@citycenterbarbershop.nl
- **Website**: https://citycenterbarbershop.nl
- **Fresha Booking**: https://www.fresha.com/a/city-center-barbershop-amsterdam-stationsplein-41m-ry7txsy7/booking

## Opening Hours

- Open on all major public holidays. Walk-ins always accepted.

## Services & Price List

- [Skin Fade (Overloop Knippen)](https://citycenterbarbershop.nl/#services): €32,50 (35 min)
- [Beard Trim & Shape (Baard Trimmen)](https://citycenterbarbershop.nl/#services): €19,50 (20 min)
- [Signature Combi (Haircut + Beard Styling)](https://citycenterbarbershop.nl/#services): €44,50 (45 min)
- [Luxury Hot Towel Shave (Traditioneel Scheren)](https://citycenterbarbershop.nl/#services): €25,00 (25 min)
- [Hair Wash & Blowdry Styling (Wassen & Föhnen)](https://citycenterbarbershop.nl/#services): €14,50 (15 min)

- [Children Haircut (Kinderen tot 12 jaar)](https://citycenterbarbershop.nl/#services): €22,50 (25 min)
